tokens.name: layout.primary
tokens.role: Wide proof band crossing a strict editorial grid. Neutral surfaces let technical content and product proof lead.

tokens.name: type.hierarchy
tokens.notes: No owner fonts are stored or specified as destination assets.
tokens.role: Use a neutral sans hierarchy. Display statements and utility labels occupy deliberately different registers.

tokens.name: color.role
tokens.notes: Color roles are analytical; preview colors are original and non-exact.
tokens.role: Code and interface views are treated as proof, not decoration.

tokens.name: interaction.priority
tokens.notes: Behavioral priority must be revalidated in the destination product.
tokens.role: Color appears when it has an interaction or identity job.

tokens.name: media.strategy
tokens.notes: Destination media requires its own rights and art direction.
tokens.role: Precise monochrome grid with a sharp proof window and sparse high-contrast controls. Use real product evidence beside its supporting claim.
